title.en: Place a sell order on CoW Swap (token allowance already in place)
title.zh-TW: 在 CoW Swap 下賣單（代幣已授權）

summary.en: The Safe calls `setPreSignature` on CoW's settlement contract to pre-sign a sell order. A solver then fills it within 30 minutes. The transaction holds only the order's hash. verify reads the full order back from CoW's API, computes the same hash, then compares the tokens, amounts and recipient one by one. The token to sell must first have an allowance for CoW's vault relayer.
summary.zh-TW: Safe 呼叫 CoW 結算合約的 `setPreSignature`，預先簽下一張賣單；solver 之後在 30 分鐘內成交。交易裡只有訂單的雜湊，verify 從 CoW 的 API 讀回訂單原文，算出同一個雜湊後，再逐項比對代幣、數量、收款人。賣的代幣要先授權給 CoW 的 vault relayer。

text.en: The hash locks the order's contents. Note that verify depends on the CoW API to read the order back.
text.zh-TW: 訂單內容由雜湊鎖住；要注意 verify 依賴 CoW API 讀回訂單。

intro.en: CoW Protocol (CoW Swap): a trading protocol that matches orders in batch auctions. Solvers compete to fill the orders.
intro.zh-TW: CoW Protocol（CoW Swap）：用批次拍賣撮合的交易協議，訂單由 solver 競標成交。

text.en: G0 Group and Hacken audited the GPv2 contracts in 2021. The reports are in the audits folder of the contracts repo.
text.zh-TW: GPv2 合約 2021 年由 G0 Group 與 Hacken 審計，報告在合約 repo 的 audits 資料夾。

text.en: The Barter solver's contract had an arbitrary-call bug, and about 166,000 USD in fees that had built up in the settlement contract was taken. Users' funds were not affected.
text.zh-TW: Barter solver 的合約有任意呼叫漏洞，被拿走結算合約裡累積的手續費約 16.6 萬美元；使用者的錢沒有受影響。

text.en: verify must read the full order back from CoW's order API (api.cow.fi). When the API cannot be read, the result is UNVERIFIABLE. The API's answer is treated only as data, and it does not count if its hash does not match.
text.zh-TW: verify 要從 CoW 的訂單 API（api.cow.fi）讀回訂單原文。API 讀不到時結果是 UNVERIFIABLE。API 回的內容只當資料，雜湊對不上就不算數。

recommendation.en: On UNVERIFIABLE, do not sign. Wait until the API is back, then run verify again.
recommendation.zh-TW: UNVERIFIABLE 時不要簽，等 API 恢復再跑一次 verify。

text.en: You type the card's "minimum to receive" yourself. The CoW app's slippage differs with each quote (smart slippage), and there is no CoW quote on chain to read.
text.zh-TW: 卡片的「最少收到的數量」要你自己填：CoW app 的滑價每次報價不同（smart slippage），鏈上也沒有 CoW 的報價可讀。

recommendation.en: Type the minimum to receive that the CoW app shows. Do not type a lower one.
recommendation.zh-TW: 照 CoW app 顯示的最少收到數量填，不要填得更低。

text.en: The app fills these two items. The template limits the expiry to at most 7 days after the block (the app sets 30 minutes) and does not limit appData (may include a 0.1% partner fee). The fill still gives no less than the minimum you type, and only to the Safe.
text.zh-TW: 這兩項 app 會自己填。到期時間模板限制在區塊時間後 7 天內（app 設 30 分鐘）；appData 模板不限制（可能含 0.1% 的合作方手續費）。成交仍不會少於你填的最少數量，也只給 Safe。

recommendation.en: Acceptable. If you no longer want the order before it expires, cancel it from the Safe.
recommendation.zh-TW: 可以接受。訂單過期前不想要了，用 Safe 撤回。

text.en: On 14 April 2026 the cow.fi domain was hijacked for several hours and served a copy of the app that asked visitors to sign malicious transactions; CoW's contracts were not hacked. verify checks only the transaction you give it against your card.
text.zh-TW: 2026 年 4 月 14 日 cow.fi 網域被劫持數小時，假的 app 讓訪客簽下惡意交易；CoW 的合約沒有被駭。verify 只拿你給它的交易比對你的卡片。

recommendation.en: Open the CoW app from a saved bookmark, and run verify on every transaction it proposes before signing.
recommendation.zh-TW: 從存好的書籤打開 CoW app，它提出的每筆交易都先跑 verify 再簽。

pastTxsConclusion.en: A sample of 161.9 days (the search hit its 50-page cap; older blocks unsearched). Most misfitting Safe orders also put an `approve` or WETH `deposit` in the batch (cow/swap-approve covers an approval of exactly the sell amount); others were buy orders, partly fillable, paid another receiver, or batched other calls. verify refuses these shapes. CoW's API answered 404 for 2 orders (cause not confirmed); verify gives UNVERIFIABLE there.
pastTxsConclusion.zh-TW: 樣本涵蓋 161.9 天，搜尋到 50 頁上限，更早的區塊沒查。不符合的 Safe 訂單多半同批加了 `approve` 或 WETH `deposit`（剛好授權賣出數量的用 cow/swap-approve）；其他是買單、可部分成交、付給別人，或同批有別的呼叫，verify 都拒絕。2 筆訂單 CoW API 回 404（原因未確認），verify 會給 UNVERIFIABLE。

1.setPreSignature.orderUid.en: The order uid, 56 bytes: the order hash, the owner and the expiry joined together. The contract only records it as "pre-signed" and does not check its contents.
1.setPreSignature.orderUid.zh-TW: 訂單 uid，56 bytes：訂單雜湊、擁有者、到期時間接在一起。合約只把它記成「已預簽」，不檢查內容。

1.setPreSignature.orderUid.digest.en: The order's EIP-712 hash. verify reads the full order back from CoW's order API and computes the hash itself. Only if the hashes match does it compare each item below.
1.setPreSignature.orderUid.digest.zh-TW: 訂單的 EIP-712 雜湊。verify 從 CoW 的訂單 API 讀回訂單原文，自己算雜湊，一樣才拿來比對下面每一項。

1.setPreSignature.orderUid.digest.receiv.en: Who gets the bought token. The CoW app fills in the Safe itself; any other address would send the money away.
1.setPreSignature.orderUid.digest.receiv.zh-TW: 買到的代幣給誰。CoW app 填 Safe 自己；填別的地址就會把錢送走。

1.setPreSignature.orderUid.digest.sellAm.en: The amount to sell. A sell order sells all of it.
1.setPreSignature.orderUid.digest.sellAm.zh-TW: 要賣的數量，賣單整筆賣出。

1.setPreSignature.orderUid.digest.buyAmo.en: The minimum amount to buy (the limit price). The settlement contract ensures the fill is no less than this.
1.setPreSignature.orderUid.digest.buyAmo.zh-TW: 最少要買到的數量（限價）。結算合約保證成交不少於這個數。

1.setPreSignature.orderUid.digest.validT.en: When the order expires (Unix seconds). The CoW Swap app sets it 30 minutes after the quote (DEFAULT_DEADLINE_FROM_NOW). The template allows at most 7 days (604,800 seconds) after the time of the block the transaction is judged on; a later expiry is MISMATCH. Within that, a later expiry only keeps the order open longer: it still fills at most once, at no less than the card's minimum, to the Safe, and the Safe can cancel it with invalidateOrder. What past transactions show: pnpm past-txs (testdata/research/cow-swap-presign.json) studied a sample of 480 transactions from 161.9 days (2026-06-15 to 2026-11-24; the search stopped at its 50-page cap, so the year's older blocks are not searched). Expiry less its block's time, on 120 orders 100 Safes pre-signed: median 1,713 seconds (about 29 minutes), 90th percentile 1,773, 99th percentile 35,629 (about 10 hours), largest 86,371 (just under 1 day); the 13 EOA orders reached at most 86,385. All fit, and 7 days is about 7 times the largest. They do not show that a bound as long as 7 days is needed: the order near 7 days that an earlier search gave as the reason is below the searched range, and no committed file holds it. So 7 days is a margin, not a measured need. The limit has no lower side: one Safe pre-signed 0x0fbccdbf2bad2847ea3c97e60315255d45f9e30ca49309d247aecb0a9c346731 226 days after its order expired (why is not confirmed). Such an order fits but cannot fill: the settlement requires validTo >= block.timestamp. An order left open for months, which a free expiry would allow, stays fillable long after the signer stops watching.
1.setPreSignature.orderUid.digest.validT.zh-TW: 訂單到期時間（Unix 秒）。CoW Swap app 設為報價後 30 分鐘（DEFAULT_DEADLINE_FROM_NOW）。模板只允許判定交易所用區塊的時間之後最多 7 天（604,800 秒）；更晚就是 MISMATCH。在這之內，較晚的到期時間只會讓訂單開著更久：它仍然最多成交一次，數量不少於卡片上的最低值，而且付給 Safe；Safe 可以用 invalidateOrder 取消它。過去交易看到的：pnpm past-txs（testdata/research/cow-swap-presign.json）從 161.9 天（2026-06-15 到 2026-11-24；搜尋停在 50 頁上限，這一年更早的區塊沒查）取樣研究 480 筆交易。100 個 Safe 預簽的 120 筆訂單，到期時間減去所在區塊時間：中位數 1,713 秒（約 29 分鐘），第 90 百分位 1,773 秒，第 99 百分位 35,629 秒（約 10 小時），最大 86,371 秒（差一點 1 天）；13 筆 EOA 的訂單最多 86,385 秒。全部符合，7 天約是最大值的 7 倍。但這些資料不能證明需要長到 7 天：先前搜尋當作理由的那筆接近 7 天的訂單，在這次範圍之前，也沒有任何已提交的檔案記著它。所以 7 天是保留的餘裕，不是量出來的需要。這個上限沒有下限：有一個 Safe 在訂單過期 226 天後才預簽（0x0fbccdbf2bad2847ea3c97e60315255d45f9e30ca49309d247aecb0a9c346731，原因未確認）。這種訂單符合規則，但不能成交：結算合約要求 validTo >= block.timestamp。到期時間若不限制，訂單可以開好幾個月，簽名者早已不再注意，它仍能成交。

1.setPreSignature.orderUid.digest.appDat.en: The hash of the JSON the app attaches to the order (app name, slippage, fees, hooks). The settlement contract does not read it.
1.setPreSignature.orderUid.digest.appDat.zh-TW: app 附在訂單上的 JSON 的雜湊（app 名稱、滑價、手續費、hooks）。結算合約不讀它。

1.setPreSignature.orderUid.digest.feeAmo.en: The fee taken inside the order. It is 0 on every CoW order today.
1.setPreSignature.orderUid.digest.feeAmo.zh-TW: 訂單內扣的手續費，現在 CoW 的訂單都是 0。

1.setPreSignature.orderUid.digest.kind.en: sell means a sell order: it sells a fixed amount and buys at least the limit.
1.setPreSignature.orderUid.digest.kind.zh-TW: sell 表示賣單：賣出固定數量，買到至少限價。

1.setPreSignature.orderUid.digest.partia.en: false means it fills all at once, not in parts.
1.setPreSignature.orderUid.digest.partia.zh-TW: false 表示一次全部成交，不分次。

1.setPreSignature.orderUid.digest.sellTo.en: erc20 means it is taken from the Safe's ordinary token balance, not through the Balancer vault.
1.setPreSignature.orderUid.digest.sellTo.zh-TW: erc20 表示從 Safe 的一般代幣餘額扣，不用 Balancer vault。

1.setPreSignature.orderUid.digest.buyTok.en: erc20 means the bought token goes straight into the Safe's ordinary balance.
1.setPreSignature.orderUid.digest.buyTok.zh-TW: erc20 表示買到的代幣直接轉進 Safe 的一般餘額。

1.setPreSignature.orderUid.owner.en: The order's owner. It must be the Safe that sends this transaction; the contract checks this too.
1.setPreSignature.orderUid.owner.zh-TW: 訂單擁有者，必須是送出這筆交易的 Safe；合約也會檢查。

1.setPreSignature.orderUid.validTo.en: The same as the expiry in the order.
1.setPreSignature.orderUid.validTo.zh-TW: 跟訂單裡的到期時間相同。

1.setPreSignature.signed.en: true means pre-sign; false means cancel.
1.setPreSignature.signed.zh-TW: true 表示預簽；false 是撤回。
